reused_test_shot_material: test-shot/plate/iron.png (B railing holdout) re-cut into plates/1959/holdout_B_iron.png; the beak contact point (1921,251) and hinge geometry from test-shot/plate/plate.json

handmade.what: 1959 interior dark hall: black field, one soft slit of daylight, floor sheen, 3.8-level grain
2009 interior hall (warm near-black with far glow), masked to the leaf opening
2059 interior opening: the plate's own through-glass view with the reflection lifted (5-px min filter) and darkened
2009 door chain: 6 shaded steel oval links (torus normals, key light upper right), slack catenary and taut states, link sprites, guard plate; link centres/angles in handmade.json
2059 7-dot sensor strip: brushed-steel bar with recessed lenses, ON (cool white) and REFUSE (amber) dot sprites with bloom, state previews
holdout mattes and pieces cut from each plate (RGBA + contour masks + failure masks) and a 960x540 lens vignette

test_shot_fixes.bird_larger: B is now 640x360 master px (was 900x506): the same 120-145 px bird reads at 33-40 % of frame height; A/C bird 220-300 master px = 19-27 %
test_shot_fixes.strikes_readable: a beak insert crop (1640,120)-(2040,345), 2.4x, with the contact point at frame (674,314): cut in for 2-4 frames on each strike or hold 5.9-6.5 s
test_shot_fixes.whites_dominate: 1959 A: 52.7 % >200 vs 28.4 % <40 (the stoop's shadow side is the one black mass); B: 39.7 % >200 vs 24.3 % <40 (the recess is the one black mass). Unify curve softened so the granite keeps mid-greys
test_shot_fixes.kept: handrail perch staging in B, the real print and its grain

section7_1959_check.verdict: measured: neutral (R-B 0), >=15 % <40 and >=20 % >200 in A and B from the real shadow side / recess; corner/centre 0.39-0.45 before the vignette layer (editor multiplies vignette_960x540, corner 0.40). Insert has 14.7 % <40 (only the recess strip) - acceptable for a 0.6 s cut-in

absences: LoC IIIF image service (tile.loc.gov/image-services/iiif/service:pnp:ppmsca:70600:70651/..., and highsm:56200:56276) returned 404 for every request on 2026-11-16; used the master TIFFs instead (70651u decoded earlier; 56276u via byte-range reads, ~17 MB)
No matched Rizzuto doorway searched: the 70651 door leaf is usable from the master (its top is cut by the print edge at y~55, so the door top never appears; framing avoids it)
No 2005-2012 Highsmith Philadelphia stoop/door found (loc.gov photos search with dates=2005/2012 returned 0 results); highsm.56276 is dated 2019 and recorded as such

2059: no Commons CC entrance that combines a few steps AND automatic sliding glass doors was found (searches: 'automatic sliding door entrance steps', 'sliding glass doors entrance stairs', incategory Automatic_doors / Sliding_doors, night entrances). Chosen plate is at grade with a threshold rail. Candidates seen and rejected: Carrefour Scheibenhard (signage, CC BY-SA), Tai Chien Building night (CJK signage + passer-by, CC0), TransGlobe Taipei Hope Square (people, logos, CC0), Donghua Building night (not viewed: thumbnail fetch failed); Hotel Ambasador Premium Lodz 1 (CC BY 4.0, thumbnail 429, not viewed)
Commons original-resolution download of the 2059 plate refused (HTTP 429 x9 with backoff); 1920 px thumbnail used
LoC search for sliding-glass-door entrances (fallback in plan section 11) returned only HABS/HAER and book records, none usable
known_gaps: 1959 A iron holdout: one thin bar (frame x~505) is only partly caught; failure mask exported (failure_A_iron.png). Perceptually judged acceptable at normal speed; puppet should not stage a crossing exactly there or should paint it from the contour
2009 iron holdout includes some of the balusters' own cast shadow on the step edge and misses the lit top of the handrail; stage the bird left of the rail
2059 grade is flat (median ~130, 0.7-2 % <40): the darks AK17 has must come from the computed long watcher shadow and the interior; consider raising the grade's contrast once the shadow is in
light directions are estimated from the plates, not measured photogrammetrically
2009 A/C come from the 1024 px service JPEG (1.6x enlargement); B is from the master
